unit_cn: Unit 1 Road to Success 成功之路
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 1 词表(真词,△超纲与专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、成功/奋斗/名人主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Hard work is often the road to success.
words.example_cn: 努力往往是通往成功之路。

words.example_en: A successful person keeps trying after failure.
words.example_cn: 成功的人在失败后仍坚持尝试。

words.example_en: Her success came after a long struggle.
words.example_cn: 她的成功来自长期的奋斗。

words.example_en: Her commitment to her work never weakened.
words.example_cn: 她对工作的投入从未减弱。

words.example_en: He is passionate about helping young scientists.
words.example_cn: 他热心于帮助年轻的科学家。

words.example_en: Winning the prize was the happiest moment in her career.
words.example_cn: 获奖是她职业生涯中最快乐的时刻。

words.example_en: The discovery was a really happy moment for the whole team.
words.example_cn: 这一发现对整个团队来说是非常快乐的时刻。

words.example_en: He coupled his talent with years of hard work.
words.example_cn: 他把天赋和多年的努力结合在一起。

words.meaning_cn: 值得做的;值得花时间(或精力)的
words.example_en: Her commitment made the long struggle worthwhile.
words.example_cn: 她的投入使长期的奋斗变得值得。

words.example_en: A modest person, she gave the credit to her team.
words.example_cn: 她为人谦逊,把功劳归于团队。

words.example_en: She spent years searching for a cure for the disease.
words.example_cn: 她花了多年寻找治疗这种疾病的方法。

words.example_en: The team searched for a new treatment in nature.
words.example_cn: 团队在自然界中寻找新的疗法。

words.example_en: They found the key to beating the disease in old books.
words.example_cn: 他们在古书中找到了战胜这种疾病的关键。

words.example_en: About a year ago he was diagnosed with cancer.
words.example_cn: 大约一年前他被诊断出患有癌症。

words.example_en: Luckily, the illness turned out to be curable with surgery.
words.example_cn: 幸运的是,这种病通过手术是可以治愈的。

words.example_en: He had the surgery and is fine now.
words.example_cn: 他做了手术,现在没事了。

words.example_en: Her team examined hundreds of old medical books.
words.example_cn: 她的团队审查了数百本古医书。

words.example_en: They interviewed many doctors to gather information.
words.example_cn: 他们采访许多医生以收集信息。

words.example_en: She summarised hundreds of old prescriptions in one collection.
words.example_cn: 她把数百个古方概括进一本集子里。

words.example_en: Her work was published as a collection of prescriptions.
words.example_cn: 她的成果以一本药方集的形式出版。

words.meaning_cn: 结论性的;确凿的;不容置疑的
words.example_en: At first the results were not conclusive enough.
words.example_cn: 起初实验结果还不够确凿。

words.meaning_cn: 分布广的;普遍的;广泛的
words.example_en: She went to the south, where the disease was widespread.
words.example_cn: 她去了南方,那里这种疾病很普遍。

words.example_en: Your time is limited, so don't waste it on someone else's life.
words.example_cn: 你的时间有限,别浪费在过别人的生活上。

words.meaning_cn: 令人惊奇的;令人惊叹的
words.example_en: When he was young there was an amazing magazine he loved.
words.example_cn: 他年轻时有一本他喜爱的了不起的杂志。

words.example_en: The words appeared on the back cover of the final issue.
words.example_cn: 这些话印在最后一期的封底上。

words.example_en: Everyone has to find his own path to success.
words.example_cn: 每个人都得找到自己通向成功的路。

words.example_en: She went to the capital to further her studies in medicine.
words.example_cn: 她去首都深造,继续她的医学研究。

words.example_en: The answer lay in a book from the East Jin dynasty.
words.example_cn: 答案藏在一本东晋时期的书中。

words.example_en: He was honoured with the title "People's Artist".
words.example_cn: 他被授予"人民艺术家"的称号。

words.example_en: His paintings of shrimps are often on display.
words.example_cn: 他画的虾常常被展出。

words.meaning_cn: (颜色的)浓淡深浅;色度;阴凉处
words.example_en: He used different shades of black ink to paint a shrimp.
words.example_cn: 他用深浅不同的黑墨来画虾。

words.example_en: His paintings of vegetables stand for a rich harvest.
words.example_cn: 他画的蔬菜象征着丰收。

words.example_en: In his art the dove is symbolic of peace.
words.example_cn: 在他的画中鸽子象征着和平。

words.example_en: His works go beyond the simple painting of fish.
words.example_cn: 他的作品超越了对鱼的简单描绘。

words.example_en: At first he based his paintings on ancient models.
words.example_cn: 起初他以古人的范本为基础作画。

words.example_en: He achieved success by coupling talent with hard work.
words.example_cn: 他凭借天赋加苦干取得了成功。

words.example_en: Reflect on your own greatest achievement and share it.
words.example_cn: 回想你自己最大的成就并分享它。

words.example_en: Grit is a significant predictor of success.
words.example_cn: 毅力是预示成功的重要因素。

words.example_en: She went away satisfied with the outcome of her work.
words.example_cn: 她对工作的结果感到满意而离开。

words.example_en: Hard work is a significant factor in any success.
words.example_cn: 努力是任何成功中的一个重要因素。

words.example_en: People with grit do well even in tough situations.
words.example_cn: 有毅力的人即使在艰难处境中也能做得好。

words.example_en: A person with grit has perseverance for long-term goals.
words.example_cn: 有毅力的人对长期目标有不屈不挠的坚持。

words.example_en: List three factors that led to your achievement.
words.example_cn: 列出促成你成就的三个因素。

words.example_en: Reflect on your achievements and write down your secrets.
words.example_cn: 反思你的成就并写下你的秘诀。

words.example_en: List the factors that contribute to this achievement.
words.example_cn: 列出促成这一成就的各个因素。

words.example_en: Through practice I have overcome my fear of public speaking.
words.example_cn: 通过练习我克服了当众讲话的恐惧。
